description: This file provides a generic implementation of background process infrastructure for a Git-related project, handling subprocess management including start, stop, handshake, and status reading.

classes.name: subprocess_entry
classes.description: Structure representing a subprocess, including command string and process info.

classes.name: child_process
classes.description: Structure encapsulating details of a child process, used internally for process management.

methods.name: int cmd2process_cmp(const void * cmp_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for subprocess entries based on command string.

methods.name: struct:subprocess_entry * subprocess_find_entry(struct hashmap * hashmap,const char * cmd)
methods.description: Finds a subprocess entry in a hashmap based on command string.

methods.name: int subprocess_read_status(int fd,struct strbuf * status)
methods.description: Reads the status from a subprocess via its file descriptor.

methods.name: void subprocess_stop(struct hashmap * hashmap,struct subprocess_entry * entry)
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up a subprocess entry.

methods.name: int subprocess_start(struct hashmap * hashmap,struct subprocess_entry * entry,const char * cmd,subprocess_start_fn startfn)
methods.description: Starts a subprocess with given command and callback function.

methods.name: int handshake_version(struct child_process * process,const char * welcome_prefix,int * versions,int * chosen_version)
methods.description: Performs a version handshake with a subprocess.

methods.name: int handshake_capabilities(struct child_process * process,struct subprocess_capability * capabilities,unsigned int * supported_capabilities)

int subprocess_handshake(struct subprocess_entry * entry,const char * welcome_prefix,int * versions,int * chosen_version,struct subprocess_capability * capabilities,unsigned int * supported_capabilities)
methods.description: Performs handshake including version and capabilities with a subprocess.

ctags.name: subprocess_handshake
